name: clipdrop
description: Descargador personal Tauri con yt-dlp para Windows y macOS
author: Nicolás Tovillas

scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:rust
scripts.check: node scripts/prepare-ui.cjs && node scripts/check.cjs && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo check --workspace
scripts.build:windows: npm run prepare:windows && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis && node scripts/collect-packages.cjs
scripts.build:mac: tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app && node scripts/collect-packages.cjs
